title: OpenAI halves API prices for GPT-6 Sol and Luna
friendlyTitle: OpenAI releases two cheaper GPT-6 models
summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as faster, lower-cost companions to GPT-6 Astra, cutting their API prices by 50% from the GPT-5.6 promotional rates. Both are available in the API and selected ChatGPT Work and Codex plans, with Luna also reaching Free and Go users in the desktop app.
friendlySummary: GPT-6 Sol and Luna bring parts of OpenAI’s newest model generation to faster and less expensive options. Their API prices are half the earlier GPT-5.6 promotional prices.
whyItMatters: Cheaper capable models make high-volume classification, coding and business automation more practical, and may let teams reserve a frontier model for the hardest steps. Model routing still needs measured quality thresholds: a low token price is not a saving if retries or human correction erase it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses can use a cheaper model for ordinary tasks and save the most powerful model for difficult work. Check the results carefully because a lower price does not help if people must fix more mistakes.
